name: @ahpd/agent-claude
description: Claude Code integration for the Agent Host Protocol. Run it as an ahpd plugin or use it directly with @ahpd/sdk.
author: Luiz Fernando Softov <lfs@softov.dev>

ahpd.title: Agent Claude
ahpd.description: Run Claude Code as an AHP agent, with independent configurations for each agent.

paths.description: Directories to include in the workspace catalog and use as default session locations. Inherits the host's paths when omitted.

computerExecutable.description: Path to the Claude CLI executable inside a computer. Defaults to 'claude' from the computer's PATH.

computerCli.description: How computers obtain the Claude CLI. 'part' (default) uses a CLI component built by the host; 'host' mounts the host's installed CLI.

computerCliFallback.description: What happens when the Claude CLI component cannot be built. 'refuse' (default) rejects the session with an error; 'host' mounts the host's installed CLI instead and logs the fallback. Applies only when computerCli is 'part'.

computerConfigDir.description: Claude CLI configuration directory inside a computer. Defaults to '/ahpd/<id>' or '/ahpd/claude' for the built-in agent. Set to false to keep the computer image's own configuration.

handshakeTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the Claude CLI handshake before treating startup as failed. Defaults to 120000 (2 minutes). Increase for slower computers.

hostTools.description: Offer the host's tools to each session. On by default. Each agent can override it.
